balls.text: very good ball. A low full-toss outside off, and drilled to long-on with his bottom hand off. Pant gets his fifty too
half a helicopter shot there! Pant is deep in his crease to this pretty full ball outside off, and swings that to the right of long-off, who fumbles a touch to allow the second
gets one away, although of the bottom edge! He is standing outside off already, as Thakur bowls a low full-toss there, with Pant trying to heave that to the on side. Lucky few runs there
Three dots in the final over. This is a near yorker outside off, and Pant squeezes it to the man at extra cover with the closed face of the bat
just inside the tramline, since it is very full and a bit wide of off. Left alone
tries to ramp that over the on side, but then opens his bat face since the ball was pretty full and a touch wide of off. The ball strikes his back pad, which was wide of off
nails this yorker on middle, as Curran inside edges it to his front boot with the closed face of the bat. Bang at the right length!
change of pace, and pretty full just outside off. Hoicked to long-off on the bounce, as he plays with his front leg out of the way

taken at deep midwicket! This time Hetmyer finds the fielder right where he was positioned. He went for the pull to this short of a length ball just outside off, but the ball seemed to have bounced more than what Hetmyer expected, and the ball came off the higher side of the bat. A very good hand from Hetmyer comes to an end, although of course it would have been ideal for Capitals had he stayed till the end

Just above Moeen running back from mid-off! Another ball right in the slot outside off, as Hetmyer lofts that with his back knee on the ground. An escape for the batter, who hadn't timed that as well with the man being inside the circle

His bat goes flying off his hands, as the ball lands just short of Chahar at third man! Looks to slice this full ball outside off, but mistimes it. Chahar runs across to his right and dives forward for an excellent attempt, but the ball just lands short of him

another one-handed slog, and Pant just clears the long-off fence! Slower ball from Bravo and in the slot on middle and leg. Pant clears his front leg, and simply lofts that with the full face of the bat for another six
very full and very wide of off. Lands beyond the pitch almost, and is called wide
yorker length and just outside off, squeezed to cover with the open face of the bat
slices that full ball wide of off over the man at extra cover. Deep point rushes to his left to cut that off
goes for the reverse-sweep, but is beaten. The ball is too full and a bit wide of off for that shot

creamed to the left of the man at long-on! Pant slogs that length ball outside off using his bottom hand, and sends that aerially and with a couple of bounces to the fence after playing from dee in his crease
takes a step across off, and drills this low full-toss outside off to deep point
rammed over the bowler's head! Stays deep in his crease and clears his front leg to this full ball in the slot outside off, and swings that expertly for four

just evades Dhoni! Dhoni thinks about a dive across to his left, but that seemed a bit far from him. Pant goes heaving to this full ball in the slot outside off, but the ball flies off his outside edge between Dhoni and Hazlewood at short third man
yorker on middle and off, and pushed to extra cover with the full face of the bat
very full and wide of off. He reaches out for it, but doesn't get a bat. Wide called
Hazlewood at short third dives to his right, and saves three runs. Pant looks to clips this very full on leg - almost a yorker in fact - but gets a leading edge behind the wicket instead
slower ball, and pretty full on middle and off. Nudged to long-off

pulled right in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket! That is the fifty stand too. This is a short delivery and a touch wide of off, as Hetmyer is deep in his crease and a little across while hammering that away
makes room and skips down a step, as he has to reach out for this pretty full ball wide of off. Pushed to deep point
another very full and wide ball outside off, and pushed to deep point with his bottom hand off
very full and pretty wide of off. Left alone, and is called wide. Thakur is not happy with the call, but he can hardly do anything with that
takes a step across off, but gets a bottom edge to this pull off a good length ball on middle and off. Thakur stops the ball to his left
drills this very full wide of off to deep point after again stretching out to play at that with his back knee grounded
third man runs to his left, but fumbles to allow two, after Pant cuts away at this short ball wide of off

one-handed six over long-on! Typical of Pant there. Slower ball - in fact an offcutter - which is a low full-toss just outside off. Pant reaches out for it a touch since he is playing from middle and leg, and swings his bat all the way. Not much power there even if he is slamming that across the line
swings this back of a length ball wide of off to long-on while playing away from his body
starts with a slower-ball bouncer, as he lands that short on middle and gets good bounce. Hetmyer gets out of the way, with the ball going on the bounce to Dhoni. Wide called for the height
taps this slower ball on a good length outside off to the right of point
change of pace again on a good length on middle, and tucked back to the bowler with the closed face of the bat
squeezes this between point and short third man! Bravo bowls very full and a bit wide outside off, as Hetmyer drills that in the gap available. Point dives to his right, but can't get a hand
slower ball slightly back of a length on middle and leg. He flicks that to fine leg with his front leg out of the way
crunches this pretty full outside off to mid-off, who is inside the circle since deep point is the only man outside the circle on the off side
on the bounce to deep midwicket, with Jadeja running across to his right! Goes to pull this shortish ball on middle and off after clearing his front leg, but doesn't get the distance
bowls slower and on a good length on off. Blocked back with the full face of the bat
fullish ball, and lands outiside leg. Pant misses his slog-sweep, and it is called wide
good length delivery on off, and turned away to deep square leg
swept to fine leg after going down on his back knee, as Moeen bowls shoritsh on middle and leg
short of a length on middle and off, and punched down to long-off

just clears deep midwicket! Again Jadeja is hurrying to his left, but the ball just about beats him after Hetmyer pulled a shortish ball on middle and off from deep in his crease. It wasn't the longer boundary there, and that helped too
fullish in length and just outside off. Flicked to deep midwicket, as Jadeja scampers to his left and rushes with the throw. Pant was halfway down for the second, but was sent back
back of a length and just outside off. Tapped to the man at point
pulls this good length ball on outside off to fine leg, with the ball keeping a touch lower than expected
another slower ball, but this is fullish outside off and angling in. Clipped to the man at midwicket
goes for the slower-ball bouncer, but that pitches on middle and off, and continues to angle away wide of the batter. Left alone, and that is a wide. First bouncer called
good length ball just outside off, and turned down toward square leg. Chahar runs across to his left to stop that, as Pant plays with the closed face of the bat
short delivery and just outside off. He pulls to deep square leg, as midwicket gives the chase to his left
starts with a slower ball which is back of a length on off, and angling in. Turned away to deep square leg, with the ball coming into him
good length delivery just outside off, and pushed to the man at cover with a hint of turn away from him
full delivery outside off, and slashed to the right of long-off. Another quick two gobbled
fullish in length and just outside off. Punched to cover, where the man dives to his left but doesn't get a hand. The ball runs down between deep point and long-off, and they pinch two
short of a length outside off, and turning away from. Pulled to deep midwicket with his bat and arm lower than usual
good length ball on leg, and coming on with the arm. Clipped to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
comes down to drill this very full ball on off to long-on, finding the gap between the legs of the non-striker
good length ball just outside off, and flicked to deep square leg

fuller an just outside off, and clipped to deep square leg. Moeen has a fumble while sliding to stop that, and the throw arrives right in the middle of the pitch and beyond it too. There is another miss across the other side of the pitch, but it is still a single despite all the drama
shorter in length and just outside off. Cut away to deep point, which is straighter
back of a length and outside off, clipped back to the left of the bowler with the closed face of the bat

lofted elegantly, but finds long-off! Looked like he checked his shot late, not entirely lofting his arms to play that aerially, as Jadeja pitched that full on off, and Shaw presented the full face of the bat. A dominant innings comes to an end
full ball just outside off, and pushed down to long-on

full just outside off. Skips down the ground, taps it to cover, and takes off for a run. Uthappa quick to pick up, and looks to throw down the stumps at the bowler's end. Pant could've been out for a duck if that was a direct hit...very tight!
full on off, and driven to wide long on for a jogging single

out or six? Taken by the sub and Moeen wins this battle. Good length ball just outside off. Axar rocks back to flat-bat a shot over Moeen. But a bit of extra bounce and he ends up mistiming the shot. Santner (on the field for Hazlewood) makes no mistake running in from long on
full on off. Turning into middle. Driven to long on for a comfortable single
good length, outside off from around the stumps. Rocks back and flat-bats a swiped shot to deep midwicket for one
length ball just outside off. Turning in, and nudged off his pads to square leg for a single
full on middle, and pushed back to the bowler's left. Ten off the over
length ball on off. Flicks to midwicket for a walking single
swept beautifully! Full on off, and Shaw is quick to get low and swipe behind square for four more!
good length outside off. Looks to cut again. Bottom-edged past Dhoni to short third man
good length, outside off. Shaw uses his fast hands to scythe a cut past point's left...and that's his fifty! In 27 balls, and the Capitals players applaud him on the effort
around the stumps. Length ball outside off and angling away. Goes deep and thumps a punched shot to long off
around the stumps, no slip this time. Length ball angling in, and flicked to deep midwicket for a jogging single
full on off. Stays patient, doesn't go for a big shot. Driven down the ground to long on for one
full on off. Smothers a shot straight back to Moeen. Bit cramped this ball
around the stumps with a slip fielder in place. Length ball on middle. Skidding through. Punched to long on for a single
fullish outside off. Turning in. Rocks back and punches past cover point for a single
full just outside off. Turning into him. Defends the first ball
full on off and middle. Tucked to midwicket where there's nobody. A comfortable single as Jadeja gives the ball a chase himself.
full on middle. Axar leans into a front-foot flick to the leg side. But leading edge takes it to cover point for one

slapped over the infield, and this has gone through Bravo's legs! Full outside off, and Axar gets it over cover. Bravo at deep point runs around to stop, but he is slow to get down. Hits the palm, through the legs, four to the total
length ball outside off. Continuing around the stumps. Stays on the back foot and clipped to deep midwicket for another one
good length, outside off. Punched to long off for one
good length on middle. Angling into leg, and looks to flick leg side. Hits the pad and rolls away to square leg
good length on leg stump once again. Flicked to midwicket. Another dot, just one off the over, and CSK end the powerplay stage strong. Capitals 51/2 after six
good length on middle. And worked off his waist to midwicket off the back foot
full and wide, and the square drive goes to backward point on the boundary line

in the air and taken by cover point running square to take it. Full on middle, angling into leg. Iyer looks to clip it away behind square leg for runs, but the leading edge took the ball in the other direction. That's two quick wickets

length ball on off. Flicked to square leg, and Iyer tries to take off for the single. But there's none there, so he has to turn back. And Moeen tries the direct hit too! Luckily for Iyer Moeen could not get the zing bails to light up
good length on off. Angling in, and tucked off his hips to midwicket

dropped by Dhoni! Thakur fooled Shaw with the slower ball, as he mistimed the cut off the slower ball. Edged and Dhoni dives to his right, but it hits his webbing instead. Hazlewood at short third man intercepts thereafter. Four runs saved or a wicket chance dropped: depending on whether you're an optimist or a pessimist.
bottom hand used! In the slot, just outside off, and Shaw purposely uses the bottom hand to shovel a lofted shot over Shardul. Holds the pose too, high elbow position and all.
wide yorker attempted. Shaw sticks his bat out to play a horizontal bat shot through point. No connection
full and wide outside off. Slaps a square drive, but Jadeja at point gets a hand to it! Saves three runs since that was flying.
rolls his fingers over the ball. Full, on middle, and nudged to midwicket for a single
hits his state teammate for six first ball! They've played each other plenty in the Mumbai and India nets. Good length, outside off, and Shaw pulls in front of square! Sweet timing
full on middle. Moves to the leg side to make room. Hazlewood follows him. Fended to the off side
full just outside off. Presses forward to drive, but checks the shot at the last moment. Along the ground to mid off's left
fullish, just outside off. Presses forward to defend
fullish just outside off. Poked to point off the back foot

the angle does the trick! Full on middle, and angling across from Dhawan. He opens the bat's face to drive through the off side. Minimal footwork, ball moves away after pitching, and there's the edge. Four and out!
hop, skip, thump! Fullish on middle and off. Dhawan runs down the ground and thwacks a shot over the umpire's head. Timing not perfect, but enough in the shot for it to dribble away for four
short and wide. And Shaw's eyes lit up as soon as he saw that length. Slaps the cut through point, and the man at deep point has no chance either!

offcutter. Length ball on off and angling into leg. Shaw stays on the back foot and flicks one behind square! Too straight from Chahar, and Shaw grabs that with both hands. Short fine leg's chase is futile
full just outside off. Wants to drive to mid off, but the ball flies off the bat's inside half to mid on
pierced! Length ball, fifth stump line. Shaw stands tall and plays a square punch through point! That was majestic
good length, corridor of uncertainty. Shaw looks to thump a slog through midwicket, but inside edged through his legs to fine leg for four! Streaky runs but Shaw will take 'em
fullish, on off. Slower ball. Tapped off the back foot to the off side, and off they go for a single

top edges a pull for a six over Dhoni! Not a great ball from Hazlewood. Back of a length ball angling into leg. Shaw looks to hammer it over the square-leg umpire....gets the result he wanted although not the way he would've liked
fullish, on middle. Dhawan walks across to the off side, exposing two stumps, and then clips behind square to the leg side for one
back of a length on off. RIsing delivery. Fended from near his face to the leg side. Off they go for one
back of a length outside off. Shaw tries to drag a pull over the leg side but top edged over the slip cordon!
good length outside off. Swipes a slog from outside the stumps, but mistimed. Midwicket gets behind it
length ball angling in, and tucked to midwicket
length ball on off. Shuffles onto the back foot and punches to Shardul at deep midwicket
good length, on middle. Nudged off his hips to square leg for a single
Chahar goes wide. Overpitched, allowing Dhawan to throw his hands at it. Slapped to Gaikwad at cover point on the circle line
good length, on off stump. Tapped of the back foot with the bat's open face to point
better line. Length ball just outside off stump. Shaw tucks it off his waist to square leg for a quick run
fullish ball, outside off. Moving away, and Shaw confidently punches to cover point. Gaikwad's there

crunches that pull to deep square leg, and wraps that up for Super Kings. Another final for his side, and Dhoni leads from the front to finish off the chase with an unbeaten 18 from just 6 balls. Curran bowls short and wide of off, and Dhoni pulls away from his body to the shorter boundary. No man at deep square means there is all the space available for him to slam that
very full and wide of off. Left alone, and that is a wide. Bonus for Super Kings

inside edge, and four more! Some luck running Super Kings' way here. Dhoni plays away from his body to this full delivery wide of off, and looks to heave at that, as the bat turns in his hands. The ball evades the off stump, and Dhoni collects four behind the wicket to beat Pant to his left
slammed over extra cover! Back of a length outside off, and gives Dhoni enough room despite going with a change of pace. Dhoni leaps in his crease, and rams that away for four

pulls, but finds deep square leg! Another blow for Super Kings here. This was bowled short and on off, and Moeen seemed to have been beaten by the lack of pace, ballooning the ball right where Rabada was waiting. That is a wicket, and of course a dot ball to start the final over
again he is beaten by the slower ball! Some cat-and-mouse stuff here. This is bowled with a change of pace, and full and wide of off. Dhoni looks to play from his crease, and misses

whack comes the sound, and the ball clears deep midwicket! Short delivery outside off, and he is sitting deep in his crease to pummel that with a pleasing sound. The boundary there was big, but he still cleared that with ease
beats Dhoni with a slower ball! He is into his pull early, and is bottom hand is off as he looks to hammer that fullish ball outside off
jams this yorker a touch wide of off, as Moeen runs that down to third man
Moeen finds the gap with that slice! Another low full-toss and a touch wide of off, as Moeen slices with the open face of the bat to deep point

Axar takes it nice and low on deep midwicket! Gaikwad went deep in his crease to hammer that low full-toss on off, but ended up getting it from the inside half of the bat. Axar had to run in forward, and then dive falling on his elbow
outside edge, flies to third man and on a few bounces to Rabada there. Looks to pull this delivery on off, but it is not all that short for that shot

dances down, and reaches out for that wide yorker outside off to slam that to deep backward point. Opens the bat face, and almost loses his bottom hand, and gets a four again. That is now 602 runs for him this season
goes for the pull, and the ball lands on the bounce to deep midwicket running forward. Short delivery just outside off, and he fails to connect
yorker on middle and off, and drilled to long-on with the closed face of the bat
good length ball just outside off, and with a change of pace. He misses his pull, as he is beaten by the lack of pace

Hetmyer at mid-off dives to his right, but can't get a hand! Gaikwad gets a half-volley just outside off, and he closes the face to loft that just past the fielder's outstretched right hand. Gaikwad now gets to 400 runs just in this UAE leg
another full-toss outside off, and heaved to deep midwicket

gentle clip, and a four! It was a near waist-high full-toss on middle, as he stood across off and flicked that between fine leg and deep square firmly, even if it was travelling to the longer part of the ground
lands a yorker wide of off, and Moeen can only jam that out to third man
change of pace on a short of a length outside off, and pulls that to long-on. Again Iyer runs to his right and throws back in time to keep that to one
bowls a full-toss wide of off, as Moeen reaches out for it to slam that to third man, which is a bit wider
starts with a slower ball on a touch short of a length on off. Pulled to deep midwicket after getting his front leg out of the way
nails this yorker on off, and keeps Moeen on his toes

pulls just between long-on and deep midwicket. The latter seemed to have been standing some feet into the boundary, and so had to run across. It was an offcutter and short of a length on middle, and Moeen timed that well in the gap
swats that good length ball on middle and leg to deep square leg. Lalit runs and slides to his left to throw that back
flicks this full delivery on his pads, but finds Axar, who is stationed right on the edge of the circle at midwicket
runs this fullish ball wide of off to third man, as he plays at that late
back of a length on his pads, and clipped behind to fine leg

slashed over point, as Rabada bowls a slower ball wide of off. Moeen was off for a second, but was sent back. The throw from Lalit Yadav, the substitute fielder for Shaw, at the bowler's end was wide, and so Moeen escaped
yorker length on off, and driven down to long-on

Iyer fires a throw to Rabada at the bowler's end, and Capitals now get Rayudu, who is run-out. The bat was well short of the crease as Rabada clipped the bails, collecting the ball very close to the stumps, with the ball bouncing high after pitching just before him. It was a slower ball on a short of a length on off, and he pulled that over midwicket. Iyer at long-on rushed to his right, and launched that throw bang to the bowler. Some late drama here
skips down after making room, but Rabada lands his yorker on middle and leg. That is nudged to long-on's left, who does well to run and cut that off. Guess the fielder? Well, Iyer again.
slower ball on a good length on off, and he taps that really late to point
full ball just outside off, and he drives with the full face of the bat to the man at cover

goes slogging, but that is taken by Iyer at long-on! A first-ball duck for Thakur, and the experiment doesn't come off. That was a back-of-a-hand slower ball from Curran, pitching pretty full and outside off. Thakur simply looked to swing his bat a touch away from his body, but sent that sailing to the man on the rope. Iyer in action again, but this catch is a lot simpler. Another blow for Super Kings
this is very full and wide of off. He tries to reach out for it, but can't get a bat. Wide called
full-toss, which is high-ish outside off. Clipped to deep midwicket to raise another half-century for him this season
cuts this short ball wide of off to the left of the man at deep point

smartly completed by Iyer at long-on after a bit of muddle there! Iyer remains composed as he is about to fall over across the rope and with Axar running across in front of him from deep midwicket. Iyer ultimately popped the ball back in the air while being forced by the momentum to go beyond the boundary, and came back in to finish it off cleanly in the end. Anyway, Uthappa looked to pull this shortish ball outside off, but seemed to have got that from the higher side of the bat. A commanding knock comes to an end
slower ball, and full and wide of off. He stretches out to push that to deep point
gets a bottom edge to short fine leg as he looks to hoick that full ball outside off
bowls full and straighter on off. Uthappa presents the full face of the bat to drive that to long-off
bowls slower and fuller on off, tapped toward cover for a single
short of a length juts outside off, and a hint of turn away from him. Driven to long-off from deep in his crease
skips down to tonk that back for four! Another full ball on middle and off, and Uthappa lifts that with a high elbow to send that four another four. Ashwin under the pump now
reverse-swept over short third man! That was a full ball on middle, and he got into position early to loft that well. That's the hundred stand as well
fullish on leg, and clipped off his pads to deep midwicket to raise the side's hundred
slower ball on a good length outside off, tickled down to third man after waiting for it to come
goes for the pull to this short delivery a touch wide of off, but is beaten. He ends up standing across off, with his feet in the air as he swung
yorker length on off, and nudged to long-on with the closed face of the bat. Rabada dives across to his right, but doesn't get a hand
looks to hoick this low full-toss outside off, but finds the the man at midwicket as he plays with the closed face of the bat

backs away to slash at that good length ball just outside off, and places that between third man and deep point. They steal three, as the ball seemed to be trickling toward the fence. Rapid running from Uthappa means the third is possible
starts with a yorker bang on off, as it is jammed back to the bowler
looks to clips this good length ball on middle and leg, but the ball strikes his pad instead
good length ball on middle, and turned away to long-on's right
slashes at this shortish ball outside off, but finds point
crashed over the bowler's head! That was full on off, and right in the slot, as he presents the full face of the bat to loft that gently

Rabada at long-on leaps behind with an outstretched right hand, but the ball just clears him! Gaikwad has to reach out for that full ball outside off, and gorgeously lofts that with the closed face of the bat
Good length ball on middle, and clipped between long-on and deep midwicket

slower ball. Full and wide. Uthappa waits, and plays the shot after waiting an extra second. Slapped to Hetmyer at deep point but can't stop the second run. Fifty for Robbie and he brings out the \m/ celebration with his hand like a horn
good length outside off. Pulled along the ground in front of square. Man is at deep midwicket
good length outside off, and he slashes a cut to deep point this time
good length outside off. Uthappa stays on the back foot, and opens the bat's face late. Runs it to third man for a single
good length outside off. Pulled from way outside off to deep midwicket for a single
full just outside off. Moves to the off side and drives down the ground
good length on middle. Turning in. Clipped off his pads to square leg
good length on middle, and leg. Nudged to square leg, and Pant has to run behind the ball
skiddy delivery on a length and angling in. Flicked to midwicket, and since there is nobody inside the circle they can come back for the second
good length on middle. Rocks back and pulls, but mistimed. Rolls to deep midwicket
full just outside off stump. Carrom ball turning away after pitching. Comes down the ground and taps it to cover
full on off, and pushed to long on for a single
good length outside off, and nudged to short third man
full just outside off. Moves to the off side and taps it to midwicket for a single
slower ball just outside off stump. Looks to defend off the front foot but the ball goes just past the outside edge
good length on off. Pulled along the ground to deep backward square leg
good length just outside off. Uthappa moves to the off side and opens the bat's face. Runs it down to third man
good length outside off. Starts off with the cutter. Swipes a shot to deep midwicket for a single
good length on off. Pulls along the ground to fine leg for a single
flatter in the air. Length ball angling in. Pushed to mid on for one
full on middle. Comes down the ground and whips a mistimed shot to the leg side for one
good length, on middle. Goes deep and pulls behind square to deep backward square leg
fullish outside off stump. Tapped to cover point for a single
full on middle, and tucked to the leg side
swatted! Ends the powerplay in style. In the slot, wider outside off, and crunched ove rmid off! CSK 59/1 in six overs
classic Robbie! You'd think he is wearing the KKR purple the way he's timing these. Length ball just outside off stump. The ball is on the up and he smacks it over Gaikwad's head for six over long on
good length outside off. Uthappa tries to play this fine to third man but misses
another one in the slog, although Avesh takes the pace off this time. Slogs to the leg side and gets enough in that mistimed shot to find the boundary at cow corner!
full just outside off. Uthappa rolls back the years as he clears the front leg before hammering a six over wide long on!
full outside off. Robin goes to the off side to drag a slog sweep to the leg side. Ball goes under the bat to the keeper
full on middle. Comes down the ground and nudges it to the leg side
inside out! Full on middle. Gaikwad moves to the leg side exposing all stumps, and then thwacks it to extra cover for four
flatter. Length ball angling in. Rocks back and pulls towards fine leg. Mistimed
full on off. Big stride forward and driven back. Axar dives to his left and intercepts
full on middle. Goes deep in his crease and swipes it to square leg
length ball in the fifth-stump line. Runs it down to third man for a single
full on his toes, and clipped very well! Uses his wrists to play it behind square, and no fielder bothers moving
another guided shot to third man. Easy singles after that initial six. Length ball once again
good length just outside off. Rocks back and fends it to the off side
good length outside off stump. Tapped to third man for a single

welcomed with a six! Gaikwad takes on one of the world's best white-ball bowlers with a six over his head. Rabada goes length ball outside off but he skips down the ground and then flat-bats a shot into the sightscreen
good length outside off stump. Another attempt at a ramp over the slip cordon. No contact
full on off stump, and clipped off his boots. Finds midwicket, Dhawan lurking
short and wide. Sticks the bat out to ramp it to third man but ends up toe-ending the shot to the fielder
